campaign.title: M2 hard-TOP product-fibre truncated-divisor scalar gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: No theorem-name continuation. A source may be used only after its exact coefficient class, derivative or transform hypotheses, absolute-value placement, parameter range, and literal product-fibre map are audited. The primary objective is a direct actual-coefficient derivation.

frozen_target.question: After the proved hm-square entry sector is removed, can the literal hard-TOP scalar be regrouped by n=hm and bounded at L^(3/2) through the actual truncated chi_4-divisor coefficient, uniformly for every real centre and every polynomial intermediate L; if not, what is the first exact divisor, resonance, completion, self-return, circularity, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: T_L^ns=L^(3/2) sum_(n asymp L^2, n not square) n^(-3/4) C_L(n)e(J sqrt(n)), where C_L(n)=sum_(h|n, h odd, sqrt(n)<=h<=2sqrt(n)) chi_4(h) eta_L(h) Phi(h/(H+1)) W(sqrt(q_X h^2/(4n))), J=sqrt(X), y=floor(J), q_X=X/y^2, H=floor(yX^(-1/4)), and the target is |T_L^ns|<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon.
quantities: the exact product-fibre bijection n=hm, h|n, sqrt(n)<=h<=2sqrt(n), m=n/h
the proved square-entry energy gives |T_L^square|<<L^(5/4)X^epsilon, so only n nonsquare remains
n asymp L^2, |C_L(n)|<=tau(n), raw scalar capacity L^(2+o(1)), and target L^(3/2+o(1))
f'(n)=J/(2sqrt(n)) asymp J/L and f''(n)=-J/(4n^(3/2)) asymp -J/L^3
the near-square divisor truncation, chi_4, Vaaler taper, dyadic height profile, endpoint W, floors, hard edge, zero extension, nonsquare condition, and real q_X are literal
support-only, parity-only, ambient spectral, product-fibre averaging, entrywise phase alignment, and positive-energy equivalence are parked controls

completion_criteria: Reproduce the exact hard-cone scalar, the square-entry removal, and the product-fibre bijection before estimating.
Derive and retain the complete truncated chi_4-divisor coefficient C_L(n), including every profile, floor, hard endpoint, nonsquare condition, and real-centre parameter.
For any derivative, exponent-pair, Poisson, B-process, Mellin, divisor-switch, or completion step, state the exact coefficient hypothesis and price the result back to L^(3/2) uniformly for 1<<L<<H.
Distinguish the full divisor identity sum_(d|n)chi_4(d)=r_2(n)/4 from the truncated near-square divisor coefficient, and do not import a circle estimate circularly.
Test prime, prime-power, many-near-square-divisor, removed-square, near-integral derivative, stationary-dual-mode, hard-face, support-crossing, phase-aligned, and opposite-character configurations.
Preserve the fixed scalar direction; do not substitute a positive energy, coefficient-uniform arbitrary array, fibrewise modulus, or averaged-centre theorem without a proved connector.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_product_fibre_reduction, or product_fibre_no_go.
Make no complete hard-TOP, BAL, UNBAL, M9-M2, M9-M1, endpoint, M9, quarter, or global-exponent promotion unless all corresponding owners and dependencies are proved.

review_seams.requirement: The exact hard cone, square projection, n=hm bijection, and literal product-fibre coefficient are reproduced without softened supports.
The truncated near-square chi_4-divisor sum is kept distinct from the full r_2 coefficient, and prime, square, and many-divisor controls are tested.
Derivative, resonant-dual, completion, and B-process calculations retain the exact real centre and all stationary/boundary modes.
Every scalar estimate is normalized back to L^(3/2) uniformly on the full polynomial intermediate range.
No positive energy, arbitrary coefficient class, fibrewise modulus, or averaged-centre theorem is substituted for the actual fixed scalar.
Only the nonsquare polynomial hard-TOP scalar may change; all other M2 owners and every downstream theorem require separate closure.

closing_assessment.main_result: The literal nonsquare hard-TOP scalar has an exact truncated near-square chi_4-divisor coefficient with energy O(L^2 log L). Each fixed squarefree radical channel has absolute mass O((1+L/sqrt(D))L^epsilon), so the unique exact phase-one nonsquare channel at a fixed centre is target-safe. Lawful divisibility completion and both direct B-processes return the original reciprocal hard-TOP principal family, while near resonances and the full truncated coefficient remain uncontrolled. A new fixed-centre actual-direction additive-twist theorem saving L^(1/2-o(1)) is still required.
